nameEn: Support activities for other mining and quarrying
description: This class includes support activities for other mining and quarrying activities, on a fee or contract basis.
includes: support activities for coal and lignite mining on a fee or contract basis
support activities for metal ore mining on a fee or contract basis
support activities for peat extraction on a fee or contract basis
overburden removal and other development work performed on a fee or contract basis
excludes: support activities for petroleum and natural gas extraction, see 0910
